name: FigJam
label: Figma REST API (FigJam files)
description: Figma REST API (FigJam files) via OfficialApiNode (nodes/figjam/api_spec.json). Official Figma REST. Canvas writes are plugin/widget only — this node is file metadata + comments. Official docs: https://www.figma.com/developers/api. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data}. Failures raise a BPMN error. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (webhook_listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One FigJam official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"file_get"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'file_get', 'comments_list', 'comment_post', 'comment_delete', 'project_files', 'webhook_listen'. webhook_listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: 'file_get'.

schema.label: file_key
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `file_key` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: ids
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `ids` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: depth
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `depth` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: message
schema.description: comment_post message text. Required for comment_post.

schema.label: client_meta
schema.description: comment_post pin position {x, y, node_id, node_offset}. Official client_meta.

schema.label: comment_id
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `comment_id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: project_id
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `project_id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: file_get, comments_list, comment_post, comment_delete, project_files, webhook_listen. Default: file_get. Selecting webhook_listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event. Example: file_get.

configurationParameters.label: Personal Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=header (configKey personal_access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
